dimension_description: This phase-one correlation scale stores the magnitude of Pearson correlation as |r|, from almost no linear association up to perfect correlation. The sign and domain context belong in qualifiers, because a strong negative correlation is just as strong as a strong positive one. This is useful pedagogically, but it is also easy to misuse: correlation depends on the variables chosen, sample definition, and whether the underlying relationship is actually linear.
